content:
The Weyburn and Area Heritage Village will take on a different atmosphere this Halloween as the City of Weyburn brings back its Paranormal Investigation event.

Paige Tenbult, communications coordinator with the City of Weyburn, says the event is returning following feedback from participants.

Hosted by Canadian Paranormal Expeditions, the event is set for Saturday, Oct. 31, with three sessions available for different age groups.

Exploring Heritage Village after dark

Participants will explore the Heritage Village alongside experienced investigators from Canadian Paranormal Expeditions.

The team will introduce paranormal investigation equipment and techniques as participants take part in the experience.

Tenbult says the event can appeal to people for a variety of reasons, whether they are interested in paranormal investigations, the history of Heritage Village or simply curious about what the site is like after dark.

Halloween atmosphere

The City first introduced its Paranormal Investigation event in 2024 and has brought it back following feedback from participants.

This year, the event has been moved to the fall, with the Halloween date adding to the atmosphere at the Heritage Village.

Tenbult says smaller group sizes will also allow participants to be more involved in the investigation.

Canadian Paranormal Expeditions will also host a best costume contest, with prizes available for the winners.

Three sessions planned

The first session runs from 4 to 7 p.m. and is open to those 12 and older.

The second session runs from 7:30 to 10:30 p.m. for those 16 and older, while the final session runs from 11 p.m. to 2 a.m. and is open to those 18 and older.

The earlier session will offer a more family-focused experience, with less darkness for younger participants, while the later sessions provide an opportunity for older participants to explore the site into the night.

Registration required

Registration is required, and spaces are limited for each session.

Those interested in attending can visit click here to find registration information.

Participants are encouraged to register early to secure a spot.
